title: HMRC Trusts and Estates newsletters
text:
HMRC publish these newsletters to give trusts and estates practitioners the latest news and updates.

 The contents of these newsletters are not legally binding on HMRC. They give HMRC’s current news and views on the date that they were published.

 You can find older newsletters on the National Archives website .
